title.en: House for sale: from listing to the buyer who asks for you
title.af: Huis te koop: van advertensie tot die koper wat na jou vra
title.zu: Indlu edayiswayo: kusukela esikhangisweni kuya kumthengi okucelayo
title.xh: Indlu ethengiswayo: ukusuka kwintengiso ukuya kumthengi okucelayo
title.nso: Ntlo ye e rekišwago: go tloga papatšong go ya go moreki yo a go kgopelago

chapters.nso: Moreki o hwetša ntlo ya gago

en: Open Quick, go to [[Property]] and tap [[List a place]]
Swipe the pictures until you see Property. One tap starts your listing.
af: Maak Quick oop, gaan na [[Property]] en tik [[List a place]]
Swiep die prente totdat jy Eiendom sien. Een tik begin jou advertensie.
zu: Vula i-Quick, iya ku-[[Property]] bese uthepha [[List a place]]
Swayipha izithombe uze ubone Izindlu. Ukuthepha kanye kuqala isikhangiso sakho.
xh: Vula i-Quick, yiya kwi-[[Property]] uze ucofe [[List a place]]
Tyibilikisa imifanekiso ude ubone Izindlu. Ukucofa kanye kuqalisa intengiso yakho.
nso: Bula Quick, eya go [[Property]] o kgotle [[List a place]]
Šuthiša diswantšho go fihlela o bona Thoto. Go kgotla gatee go thoma papatšo ya gago.

en: Tap [[House]]
A flat, townhouse, plot, farm or commercial place follows the same steps.
af: Tik [[House]]
'n Woonstel, meenthuis, erf, plaas of sakeperseel volg dieselfde stappe.
zu: Thepha [[House]]
Ifulethi, i-townhouse, isiza, ipulazi noma indawo yebhizinisi kulandela izinyathelo ezifanayo.
xh: Cofa [[House]]
Iflethi, i-townhouse, isiza, ifama okanye indawo yoshishino zilandela amanyathelo afanayo.
nso: Kgotla [[House]]
Folete, ntlo ya mothalo, setsha, polase goba lefelo la kgwebo di latela dikgato tše di swanago.

en: Tap [[To sell]]
Letting it instead? Tap To let: Quick then asks the rent a month.
af: Tik [[To sell]]
Wil jy dit eerder verhuur? Tik To let: Quick vra dan die huur per maand.
zu: Thepha [[To sell]]
Uyayiqashisa esikhundleni salokho? Thepha To let: i-Quick izobe isibuza irenti ngenyanga.
xh: Cofa [[To sell]]
Uyayiqeshisa endaweni yoko? Cofa To let: i-Quick iza kubuza irente ngenyanga.
nso: Kgotla [[To sell]]
O e hirišetša go na le moo? Kgotla To let: Quick e tla botšiša rente ka kgwedi.

en: Tap how many bedrooms
A plot or a commercial place skips this question.
af: Tik hoeveel slaapkamers
'n Erf of sakeperseel slaan hierdie vraag oor.
zu: Thepha ukuthi mangaki amakamelo okulala
Isiza noma indawo yebhizinisi yeqa lo mbuzo.
xh: Cofa mangaphi amagumbi okulala
Isiza okanye indawo yoshishino iyawutsiba lo mbuzo.
nso: Kgotla gore ke diphapoši tše kae tša go robala
Setsha goba lefelo la kgwebo di tshela potšišo ye.

en: Tap your area
Not in the list? Tap Another option and type it. Quick asks your city once, then remembers it.
af: Tik jou area
Nie in die lys nie? Tik Another option en tik dit in. Quick vra jou stad een keer en onthou dit.
zu: Thepha indawo yakho
Ayikho ohlwini? Thepha Another option bese uyibhala. I-Quick ibuza idolobha lakho kanye, bese ilikhumbula.
xh: Cofa indawo yakho
Ayikho kuluhlu? Cofa Another option uze uyibhale. I-Quick ibuza isixeko sakho kube kanye, emva koko isikhumbule.
nso: Kgotla lefelo la gago
Ga le gona lenaneong? Kgotla Another option o le ngwale. Quick e botšiša toropo ya gago gatee, ke moka e e gopole.

en: Type your asking price, then tap [[Next]]
Type it the way you say it: 2 450 000 or 2.45m. It shows on your listing as R2 450 000.
af: Tik jou vraprys, dan [[Next]]
Tik dit soos jy dit sê: 2 450 000 of 2.45m. Dit wys op jou advertensie as R2 450 000.
zu: Bhala intengo oyifunayo, bese [[Next]]
Yibhale ngendlela oyisho ngayo: 2 450 000 noma 2.45m. Ivela esikhangisweni sakho njengo-R2 450 000.
xh: Bhala ixabiso olifunayo, emva koko [[Next]]
Libhale ngendlela olithetha ngayo: 2 450 000 okanye 2.45m. Libonakala kwintengiso yakho njengo-R2 450 000.
nso: Ngwala theko ye o e nyakago, ke moka [[Next]]
E ngwale ka mo o e bolelago ka gona: 2 450 000 goba 2.45m. E bonala papatšong ya gago bjalo ka R2 450 000.

en: Check your listing, then tap [[Save my listing]]
Saving is free. The photo is only an example until you add your own in the app.
af: Kyk na jou advertensie, dan [[Save my listing]]
Stoor is gratis. Die foto is net 'n voorbeeld totdat jy jou eie in die app byvoeg.
zu: Hlola isikhangiso sakho, bese [[Save my listing]]
Ukugcina kumahhala. Isithombe siyisibonelo nje uze ufake esakho ku-app.
xh: Jonga intengiso yakho, emva koko [[Save my listing]]
Ukugcina simahla. Umfanekiso ngumzekelo nje ude ufake owakho kwi-app.
nso: Lekola papatšo ya gago, ke moka [[Save my listing]]
Go boloka ke mahala. Seswantšho ke mohlala feela go fihlela o tsenya sa gago go app.

en: Saved: tap [[Sign the terms and publish]]
Your listing is kept, and we email you a link to it too. Nobody sees it until you publish.
af: Gestoor: tik [[Sign the terms and publish]]
Jou advertensie is bewaar, en ons e-pos jou ook 'n skakel daarna. Niemand sien dit voordat jy publiseer nie.
zu: Kugciniwe: thepha [[Sign the terms and publish]]
Isikhangiso sakho sigciniwe, futhi sikuthumelela isixhumanisi nge-imeyili. Akekho osibonayo uze usishicilele.
xh: Kugciniwe: cofa [[Sign the terms and publish]]
Intengiso yakho igciniwe, kwaye sikuthumelela ikhonkco nge-imeyile. Akukho mntu uyibonayo ude uyipapashe.
nso: E bolokilwe: kgotla [[Sign the terms and publish]]
Papatšo ya gago e bolokilwe, gape re go romela kgokagano ka imeile. Ga go yo a e bonago go fihlela o e phatlalatša.

en: TrustSquare opens your Seller Hub: tap [[Edit]]
Your listing waits here as a draft. Edit is where you add your own photos and the details.
af: TrustSquare maak jou Verkopersentrum oop: tik [[Edit]]
Jou advertensie wag hier as 'n konsep. Edit is waar jy jou eie foto's en die besonderhede byvoeg.
zu: I-TrustSquare ivula i-Seller Hub yakho: thepha [[Edit]]
Isikhangiso sakho silinde lapha njengokusalungiswa. Ku-Edit yilapho ufaka khona izithombe zakho nemininingwane.
xh: I-TrustSquare ivula i-Seller Hub yakho: cofa [[Edit]]
Intengiso yakho ilinde apha njengedrafti. Ku-Edit kulapho ufaka khona imifanekiso yakho neenkcukacha.
nso: TrustSquare e bula Seller Hub ya gago: kgotla [[Edit]]
Papatšo ya gago e emetše mo bjalo ka kakanyo. Edit ke moo o tsenyago diswantšho tša gago le dintlha.

en: Add your photos and the details, then tap [[Save Changes]]
Bathrooms, garages, floor and erf size, and a few lines about the house. Keep the street number and your phone number off the photos: the address is only shared after an introduction.
af: Voeg jou foto's en die besonderhede by, dan [[Save Changes]]
Badkamers, motorhuise, vloer- en erfgrootte, en 'n paar reëls oor die huis. Hou die straatnommer en jou foonnommer uit die foto's: die adres word eers ná 'n voorstelling gedeel.
zu: Faka izithombe zakho nemininingwane, bese [[Save Changes]]
Amagumbi okugeza, amagaraji, ubukhulu bephansi nesiza, nemigqa embalwa ngendlu. Ungabonisi inombolo yomgwaqo nenombolo yakho yefoni ezithombeni: ikheli labelwana ngalo kuphela ngemva kokwethulwa.
xh: Faka imifanekiso yakho neenkcukacha, emva koko [[Save Changes]]

Amagumbi okuhlambela, iigaraji, ubungakanani bomgangatho nesiza, nemigca embalwa ngendlu. Musa ukubonisa inombolo yesitrato nenombolo yakho yefowuni kwimifanekiso: idilesi yabelwana ngayo kuphela emva kokwaziswa.
nso: Tsenya diswantšho tša gago le dintlha, ke moka [[Save Changes]]

Diphapoši tša go hlapela, dikaratšhe, bogolo bja lebato le setsha, le methalo e mmalwa ka ntlo. O se bontšhe nomoro ya seterata le nomoro ya gago ya mogala diswantšhong: aterese e abelanwa feela ka morago ga tsebišo.

en: Read the seller terms, tick both boxes, tap [[I accept]]
Once only, at your first save. Your changes stay on the screen while you read.
af: Lees die verkopersvoorwaardes, merk albei blokkies, tik [[I accept]]
Net een keer, met jou eerste stoor. Jou veranderinge bly op die skerm terwyl jy lees.
zu: Funda imigomo yomthengisi, maka womabili amabhokisi, thepha [[I accept]]
Kanye kuphela, lapho ugcina okokuqala. Izinguquko zakho zihlala esikrinini ngenkathi ufunda.
xh: Funda imiqathango yomthengisi, phawula omabini amabhokisi, cofa [[I accept]]
Kube kanye kuphela, xa ugcina okokuqala. Utshintsho lwakho luhlala kwisikrini ngelixa ufunda.
nso: Bala dipego tša morekiši, swaya mapokisi ka bobedi, kgotla [[I accept]]
Gatee feela, ge o boloka la mathomo. Diphetogo tša gago di dula sekrining ge o bala.

en: Back in your Seller Hub, tap [[Publish]]
Publishing is free. Your house goes live at once.
af: Terug in jou Verkopersentrum, tik [[Publish]]
Publiseer is gratis. Jou huis is dadelik op die webwerf.
zu: Ubuyele ku-Seller Hub yakho, thepha [[Publish]]
Ukushicilela kumahhala. Indlu yakho ivela khona manjalo.
xh: Ubuyele kwi-Seller Hub yakho, cofa [[Publish]]
Ukupapasha simahla. Indlu yakho iyabonakala kwangoko.
nso: O boetše go Seller Hub ya gago, kgotla [[Publish]]
Go phatlalatša ke mahala. Ntlo ya gago e bonala gona bjale.

en: Your house is live
Buyers can find it now. Your name, number and street address stay hidden until you accept an introduction.
af: Jou huis is aanlyn
Kopers kan dit nou vind. Jou naam, nommer en straatadres bly versteek totdat jy 'n voorstelling aanvaar.
zu: Indlu yakho isivela
Abathengi bangayithola manje. Igama lakho, inombolo nekheli lomgwaqo kuhlala kufihliwe uze wamukele ukwethulwa.
xh: Indlu yakho iyabonakala
Abathengi banokuyifumana ngoku. Igama lakho, inombolo nedilesi yesitrato zihlala zifihliwe ude wamkele ukwaziswa.
nso: Ntlo ya gago e a bonala
Bareki ba ka e hwetša bjale. Leina la gago, nomoro le aterese ya seterata di dula di utilwe go fihlela o amogela tsebišo.

en: A buyer opens Quick and taps [[Find a place]]
She picks House and Buying, then her area.
af: 'n Koper maak Quick oop en tik [[Find a place]]
Sy kies House en Buying, dan haar area.
zu: Umthengi uvula i-Quick bese ethepha [[Find a place]]
Ukhetha u-House no-Buying, bese kuba indawo yakhe.
xh: Umthengi uvula i-Quick aze acofe [[Find a place]]
Ukhetha u-House no-Buying, emva koko indawo yakhe.
nso: Moreki o bula Quick a kgotla [[Find a place]]
O kgetha House le Buying, ke moka lefelo la gagwe.

en: Your house is in her results
Real listings show their own photo and price. AI examples are always marked AI EXAMPLE LISTING.
af: Jou huis is in haar resultate
Regte advertensies wys hul eie foto en prys. KI-voorbeelde is altyd gemerk AI EXAMPLE LISTING.
zu: Indlu yakho iphakathi kwemiphumela yakhe
Izikhangiso zangempela zibonisa isithombe nentengo yazo. Izibonelo ze-AI zihlala zimakwe ngo-AI EXAMPLE LISTING.
xh: Indlu yakho iphakathi kweziphumo zakhe
Iintengiso zokwenyani zibonisa umfanekiso nexabiso lazo. Imizekelo ye-AI ihlala iphawulwe ngo-AI EXAMPLE LISTING.
nso: Ntlo ya gago e gare ga dipoelo tša gagwe
Dipapatšo tša nnete di bontšha seswantšho le theko ya tšona. Mehlala ya AI e dula e swailwe ka AI EXAMPLE LISTING.

en: She taps it: your listing opens in TrustSquare
Price, bedrooms, bathrooms, sizes and your trust score. Your name and address are not shown.
af: Sy tik dit: jou advertensie maak in TrustSquare oop
Prys, slaapkamers, badkamers, groottes en jou vertrouetelling. Jou naam en adres word nie gewys nie.
zu: Uyathepha: isikhangiso sakho sivuleka ku-TrustSquare
Intengo, amakamelo okulala, amagumbi okugeza, ubukhulu namaphuzu akho okwethenjwa. Igama lakho nekheli akuboniswa.
xh: Uyacofa: intengiso yakho ivuleka kwi-TrustSquare
Ixabiso, amagumbi okulala, amagumbi okuhlambela, ubungakanani namanqaku akho okuthembeka. Igama lakho nedilesi azibonakali.
nso: O a e kgotla: papatšo ya gago e bulega go TrustSquare
Theko, diphapoši tša go robala, tša go hlapela, bogolo le dintlha tša gago tša tshepo. Leina la gago le aterese ga di bontšhwe.

en: She checks your price against the area
[[Is this a fair price?]] gives a free area guide: the usual price per square metre there, worked out for your floor size.
af: Sy vergelyk jou prys met die area
[[Is this a fair price?]] gee 'n gratis areagids: die gewone prys per vierkante meter daar, uitgewerk vir jou vloergrootte.
zu: Uqhathanisa intengo yakho nendawo
[[Is this a fair price?]] inika umhlahlandlela wendawo wamahhala: intengo evamile ngemitha-skwele lapho, ibalelwe ubukhulu bephansi lendlu yakho.
xh: Uthelekisa ixabiso lakho nendawo
[[Is this a fair price?]] inika isikhokelo sendawo simahla: ixabiso eliqhelekileyo ngemitha-skwere apho, libalelwe ubungakanani bomgangatho wendlu yakho.
nso: O bapetša theko ya gago le lefelo
[[Is this a fair price?]] e fa tlhahli ya lefelo ya mahala: theko ye e tlwaelegilego ka mitara-sekwere moo, e balelwa bogolo bja lebato la ntlo ya gago.

en: She can ask for the [[Property Area Dossier]]
Right under the price checks. One tap opens it with your house already filled in.
af: Sy kan die [[Property Area Dossier]] vra
Reg onder die pryskontroles. Een tik maak dit oop met jou huis reeds ingevul.
zu: Angacela i-[[Property Area Dossier]]
Ngaphansi nje kokuhlolwa kwentengo. Ukuthepha kanye kuyivula nendlu yakho isivele igcwalisiwe.
xh: Angacela i-[[Property Area Dossier]]
Ngaphantsi nje kokujongwa kwexabiso. Ukucofa kanye kuyivula nendlu yakho sele igcwalisiwe.
nso: A ka kgopela [[Property Area Dossier]]
Ka tlase ga ditlhahlobo tša theko. Go kgotla gatee go e bula ntlo ya gago e šetše e tladitšwe.

en: She taps [[Get the report · 3T]]
Houses for sale nearby, what her budget buys, schools, commute and running costs. The Tuppence is only taken when the report arrives.
af: Sy tik [[Get the report · 3T]]
Huise te koop in die omgewing, wat haar begroting koop, skole, pendel en lopende koste. Die Tuppence word eers geneem wanneer die verslag aankom.
zu: Uthepha [[Get the report · 3T]]
Izindlu ezidayiswayo eduze, lokho okuthengwa yisabelomali sakhe, izikole, ukugibela nezindleko. I-Tuppence ithathwa kuphela uma umbiko ufika.
xh: Ucofa [[Get the report · 3T]]
Izindlu ezithengiswayo kufutshane, oko kuthengwa luhlahlo-lwabiwo-mali lwakhe, izikolo, uhambo neendleko. I-Tuppence ithathwa kuphela xa ingxelo ifika.
nso: O kgotla [[Get the report · 3T]]
Dintlo tše di rekišwago kgauswi, seo tekanyetšo ya gagwe e se rekago, dikolo, leeto le ditshenyagalelo. Tuppence e tšewa feela ge pego e fihla.

en: She taps [[Request introduction]] and writes you a line
1 Tuppence is held when she sends it and only spent if you accept. While she waits, your listing pauses for other buyers.
af: Sy tik [[Request introduction]] en skryf vir jou 'n reël
1 Tuppence word gehou wanneer sy dit stuur en net bestee as jy aanvaar. Terwyl sy wag, rus jou advertensie vir ander kopers.
zu: Uthepha [[Request introduction]] bese ekubhalela umugqa
I-Tuppence engu-1 iyabanjwa uma ethumela futhi isetshenziswa kuphela uma wamukela. Ngenkathi elinde, isikhangiso sakho siyama kwabanye abathengi.
xh: Ucofa [[Request introduction]] aze akubhalele umgca
I-Tuppence e-1 iyabanjwa xa ethumela kwaye isetyenziswa kuphela ukuba uyamkela. Ngelixa elindile, intengiso yakho iyanqumama kwabanye abathengi.
nso: O kgotla [[Request introduction]] a go ngwalela mothalo
Tuppence e 1 e a swarwa ge a e romela gomme e šomišwa feela ge o amogela. Ge a sa letile, papatšo ya gago e ema go bareki ba bangwe.

en: Request sent
The first time, she accepts the TrustSquare terms once. Then: Request sent, listing paused.
af: Versoek gestuur
Die eerste keer aanvaar sy die TrustSquare-voorwaardes een keer. Dan: Request sent, listing paused.
zu: Isicelo sithunyelwe
Okokuqala, wamukela imigomo ye-TrustSquare kanye. Bese: Request sent, listing paused.
xh: Isicelo sithunyelwe
Okokuqala, wamkela imiqathango ye-TrustSquare kube kanye. Emva koko: Request sent, listing paused.
nso: Kgopelo e rometšwe
La mathomo, o amogela dipego tša TrustSquare gatee. Ke moka: Request sent, listing paused.

en: You see her request in your Seller Hub
Her first name and her message. Tap [[✓ Accept]] or [[✕ Decline]]. We also email you.
af: Jy sien haar versoek in jou Verkopersentrum
Haar voornaam en haar boodskap. Tik [[✓ Accept]] of [[✕ Decline]]. Ons e-pos jou ook.
zu: Ubona isicelo sakhe ku-Seller Hub yakho
Igama lakhe lokuqala nomyalezo wakhe. Thepha [[✓ Accept]] noma [[✕ Decline]]. Siphinde sikuthumelele i-imeyili.
xh: Ubona isicelo sakhe kwi-Seller Hub yakho
Igama lakhe lokuqala nomyalezo wakhe. Cofa [[✓ Accept]] okanye [[✕ Decline]]. Sikuthumelela ne-imeyile.
nso: O bona kgopelo ya gagwe go Seller Hub ya gago
Leina la gagwe la pele le molaetša wa gagwe. Kgotla [[✓ Accept]] goba [[✕ Decline]]. Re go romela le imeile.

en: Accept: you are introduced
Accepting costs you nothing: her 1 Tuppence is spent now. You both get an email; reply to it to talk, and arrange the viewing. Your listing is open to other buyers again.
af: Aanvaar: julle word voorgestel
Aanvaar kos jou niks: haar 1 Tuppence word nou bestee. Julle kry albei 'n e-pos; antwoord daarop om te praat en reël die besigtiging. Jou advertensie is weer oop vir ander kopers.
zu: Yamukela: niyethulwa

Ukwamukela akukubizi lutho: i-Tuppence yakhe engu-1 isetshenziswa manje. Nobabili nithola i-imeyili; yiphendule ukuze nikhulume, nihlele ukubuka indlu. Isikhangiso sakho siphinde sivuleleke kwabanye abathengi.
xh: Yamkela: niyaziswa

Ukwamkela akukuxabisi nto: i-Tuppence yakhe e-1 isetyenziswa ngoku. Nobabini nifumana i-imeyile; yiphendule ukuze nithethe, nilungiselele ukubona indlu. Intengiso yakho iphinda ivulelwe abanye abathengi.
nso: Amogela: le a tsebišwa

Go amogela ga go go lefiše selo: Tuppence ya gagwe e 1 e šomišwa bjale. Ka bobedi le hwetša imeile; e arabe gore le boledišane, le rulaganye go bona ntlo. Papatšo ya gago e bulegela bareki ba bangwe gape.

en: She sees it under [[My Requests]]
Every introduction she asked for, and where it stands: Accepted, check your email.
af: Sy sien dit onder [[My Requests]]
Elke voorstelling wat sy gevra het, en waar dit staan: Accepted, check your email.
zu: Ukubona ngaphansi kwe-[[My Requests]]
Konke ukwethulwa akucelile, nokuthi kumi kuphi: Accepted, check your email.
xh: Ukubona phantsi kwe-[[My Requests]]
Konke ukwaziswa akucelileyo, nokuba kumi phi: Accepted, check your email.
nso: O e bona ka fase ga [[My Requests]]
Tsebišo ye nngwe le ye nngwe ye a e kgopetšego, le moo e lego gona: Accepted, check your email.

en: Pass Quick on
On Quick's first screen, tap Share: they scan the code or you send the link. They get their own Quick, never your listing or your number.
af: Gee Quick aan
Op Quick se eerste skerm, tik Share: hulle skandeer die kode of jy stuur die skakel. Hulle kry hul eie Quick, nooit jou advertensie of jou nommer nie.
zu: Dlulisela i-Quick
Esikrinini sokuqala se-Quick, thepha Share: bafaka ikhodi kukhamera noma uthumela isixhumanisi. Bathola i-Quick yabo, hhayi isikhangiso sakho noma inombolo yakho.
xh: Dlulisela i-Quick
Kwisikrini sokuqala se-Quick, cofa Share: baskena ikhowudi okanye uthumela ikhonkco. Bafumana eyabo i-Quick, hayi intengiso yakho okanye inombolo yakho.
nso: Fetišetša Quick pele
Sekrining sa mathomo sa Quick, kgotla Share: ba skena khoutu goba o romela kgokagano. Ba hwetša Quick ya bona, e sego papatšo ya gago goba nomoro ya gago.
